content.text: I'll help you create an open-top box with the specified dimensions. Let me first calculate the inner dimensions and positions needed for creating this box using the block function.

input.PythonCode:
# Outer dimensions
outer_x = 220  # mm
outer_y = 300  # mm
outer_z = 160  # mm

# Wall thickness and bottom thickness
wall_thickness = 8  # mm
bottom_thickness = 12  # mm

# Calculate inner dimensions
inner_x = outer_x - 2 * wall_thickness  # subtract wall thickness from both sides
inner_y = outer_y - 2 * wall_thickness  # subtract wall thickness from both sides
inner_z = outer_z - bottom_thickness  # subtract only bottom thickness (open top)

# Calculate position for inner block (to be subtracted)
# The inner block should start at the bottom thickness level and be centered in x,y
inner_x_pos = wall_thickness
inner_y_pos = wall_thickness
inner_z_pos = bottom_thickness

print(f"Outer block dimensions: {outer_x} x {outer_y} x {outer_z} mm")
print(f"Inner block dimensions: {inner_x} x {inner_y} x {inner_z} mm")
print(f"Inner block position: ({inner_x_pos}, {inner_y_pos}, {inner_z_pos})")
